outputs.explanation: Panel shows a calculated percentage of illumination overhead for each fixed exposure-time setting (a proportional bar diagram), not an average of replicate measurements with variability, so individual data points are not applicable.
Line plot of photobleaching decay curves (mean±s.e.m. shaded); line plots are exempt from requiring individual data point overlays.
Scatter plot of ΔROS vs exposure time with error bars per condition; scatter plots are exempt from requiring individual point overlays.
Each panel displays individual migration tracks for every single cell (line plot of raw trajectories), so individual data is already shown; no averaging is depicted here.
Bar chart of mean±s.e.m. migration speed has individual cell data points (dots) overlaid on each bar.
Panel F consists of micrographs (MitoTracker/Paxillin images), not a plot of averaged data.
Panel G is a time-series of micrographs, not a plot of averaged data.
Panel H is a time-series of micrographs, not a plot of averaged data.
Line plot of normalized cell area over time (mean±s.e.m.); line plots are exempt from requiring individual point overlays.
Line plot of normalized mitochondrial area over time (mean±s.e.m.); line plots are exempt from requiring individual point overlays.
